video_title: Did the Pistons really offer Jalen Duren ONLY 25 million a year 😳

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons' lowball offer to Jalen Duren is disrespectful
quotes.excerpt: To not give the man at least 35 a year is insane.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The Pistons offers were reportedly in the 25 million per year range. Ray, is this disrespectful?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I totally agree with him not getting that full max that he's qualified for. Totally agree. I don't feel like he did enough to deserve all that money, but to not give the man at least 35 a year is insane. He deserves that right now.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit's business strategy regarding Jalen Duren's contract
quotes.excerpt: Austin Reaves got his deal done because they saw Detroit was making room for him.
quotes.quote: Austin Reaves got his deal done because they saw Detroit was making room for him. They see nobody is doing that for Jalen Duren. The Lakers are gone. There is no one that can go pay him. Detroit is not wrong for what they are doing. They are not wrong because they don't have to sign more people. You are able to sign more people if you give him less money, and I am okay with that. I came back and I said I am okay with giving him less money, but 25 is crazy though, y'all.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of the new CBA on player contracts
quotes.excerpt: With the new CBA, if I don't have to, I'm not going to do it.
quotes.quote: With the new CBA, if I don't have to, I'm not going to do it. Because at the end of the day, that literally strongholds what you can do in the future. And if he is the only guys that are going to get paid from here on out with the way the CBA is negotiated right now, the only guys that are going to get big paydays are the Tatums, the Shays, the Ants, the superstars. The got your franchise guys are going to be making that. That's it.
